Our procurement team asked whether Redwood can provide a structured pricing parity offer and a low-risk migration path. Specifically:

- Can you match our incumbent's blended price for the next 12 months (we've shared anonymized invoices with procurement)?
- If not an exact match, do you offer a staged-credit plan tied to usage that reduces up-front impact?
- We also need a fallback/compatibility assurance if some models don't behave identically (runtime parity + KV cache considerations).

We'd like a brief runbook and a mutual action plan (MAP) showing timing, credits, and what constitutes successful parity for our SREs.

Elena — great to hear from you and glad the demo resonated. Short answer: yes, we can structure a parity-forward offer without jeopardizing our capacity economics. I outlined an approach below and we'll follow up with a formal MAP and term sheet: 

1) Staged credit ladder: a 6–12 month tiered credit (eg. 20% initial credit that phases down as run-rate ramps) tied to token volume milestones. Credits apply to hosted API and can be used for private deployment setup costs.

2) Runtime parity guardrails: we will provide a fallback policy that routes requests to a certified compatible model variant + a KV-cache migration test suite to validate behavioral drift < 3% on your eval prompts.

3) Escrowed performance commitment: for dedicated/Private installs we can include a short SLA credit if p90 latency exceeds agreed thresholds during pilot windows.

Marissa (cc'd) will share the pricing bands and a draft MAP workbook. Sean will own the technical migration runbook and KV cache test plan.

I attached a short one-pager and will follow with the MAP spreadsheet Monday.

Cheers,

Elena / team — attaching pricing bands for clarity. Two callouts: 1) we can do a volume-accelerator credit that front-loads value during the first 90 days; 2) an integration credit bucket (one-time) to offset migration engineering costs for private deployments.

Key numbers (summary):
- Tier A (0–5M tokens/mo): list price $0.012/token, staged credit 18% for months 1–3, 10% months 4–6.
- Tier B (5–20M tokens/mo): list price $0.009/token, staged credit 22% for months 1–3, 12% months 4–6.
- Dedicated private deployment: one-time integration credit up to $75k for migration; SLA credit for p90 latency misses up to 5% of monthly invoice for the first 3 months of production.

We also propose a performance-acceptance checklist: model equivalence eval (90/10 pass threshold on your prompt set), KV cache smoke test, circuit-breaker routing to incumbent for edge cases. If you want we can include a short 30-day pilot (reduced rate + credits) before any long-term commitment.
